source: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates (EXR)

columns.date: ECB reference rate date (TARGET business days)
columns.eur_try: TRY per 1 EUR, as published by the ECB
columns.eur_usd: USD per 1 EUR, as published by the ECB
columns.usd_try: TRY per 1 USD, derived by this project as eur_try / eur_usd (not an ECB statistic)
